15 – 14 ÷ 21 × 27 + 9 = 64

questions.solution:
Let the number be a.

According to question: 

a + (a + 1) + 3(a + 1) = 64

⇒ a + a + 1 + 3a + 3 = 64

⇒ 5a + 4 = 64 

⇒ 5a = 64 - 4

⇒ 5a = 60

⇒ a = 60 ÷ 5

⇒ a = 12 

Hence, '**12**' is the correct answer.

• In the constitution, there is nowhere mentioned the term Budget.

• India's first Union Budget was presented by the **first Finance minister, RK Shanmukham Chetty on November 26, 1947**.

• There are three types of budgets which are **Balanced Budget, Surplus Budget and Deficit Budget**.
 
 
• Balanced Budget – A government Budget is assumed to be balanced if the expected expenditure is equal to the anticipated receipts for a fiscal year.
 
• Surplus Budget – A Budget is said to be surplus when the expected revenues surpass the estimated expenditure for a particular business year.
 
• Deficit Budget- A Budget is in deficit if the expenditure surpasses the revenue for a designated year.
